name: Season podium
description: The podium the close froze (season_podium), first to third on each ladder: one place per owner, each owner's best version standing for them, baselines skipped. Each place carries its owner's newest counted match of that season to watch (match_ref_json), read backwards off the owner's versions' rating_events. season_cache: a closed podium never changes. Read, never re-ranked: the podium of a closed season is what it closed on. A live season answers with no ladders. 404 for an unknown game or season.
